name: Storm Burger
facts: Storm Burger has two open locations: Inglewood (1500 N La Brea Ave, 90302) and Long Beach (5801 Cherry Ave, 90805). Compton (336 W Alondra Blvd) is coming soon.
Inglewood hours: Sun-Thu 10:30 AM-12 AM, Fri-Sat 10:30 AM-1 AM.
Long Beach hours: Mon-Wed 10:30 AM-10 PM, Thu-Sun 10:30 AM-11 PM.
Rewards: 20 points per $1 when staff ring you up.
Reward ladder: 1,000 pts Free fries, 1,800 Free shake, 3,000 Free Classic StormBurger, 4,500 Free combo.
Bonuses: 50 pts for a daily QR check-in, 100 for your first order, 200 on your birthday, 250 for in-app feedback.
Referral: you get 150 pts when a friend joins, and the friend gets 50 pts and a free fries.
Storm Run is a free driving game. Steer a food truck, grab coins and food, and dodge hazards.
Storm Run prizes: 400 = Free house sauce, 600 = Free fries or onion rings, 800 = Free milkshake, 1,000 = Free Classic StormBurger.
The weekly top Storm Run score wins a Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo. The board resets every Monday.
The Daily Spin is free: one spin per member per day.
Game prizes and spin food prizes are good for 3 days, one reward per visit, at either location.
Combos include fries and a soft drink. Upgrade fries to onion rings +$2.00 or the drink to a milkshake +$2.00.
Your info is only used for your rewards account and is never sold.
The app has a language menu with 12 languages.
suggested: How do I play Storm Run?

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Inglewood: Sun-Thu 10:30 AM-12 AM, Fri-Sat 10:30 AM-1 AM. Long Beach: Mon-Wed 10:30 AM-10 PM, Thu-Sun 10:30 AM-11 PM.

qa.q: What time do you open?
qa.a: Both locations open at 10:30 AM every day.

qa.q: How late are you open at Inglewood?
qa.a: Inglewood is open until 12 AM Sunday through Thursday and until 1 AM Friday and Saturday.

qa.q: How late is Long Beach open?
qa.a: Long Beach closes at 10 PM Monday through Wednesday and at 11 PM Thursday through Sunday.

qa.q: Are you open on weekends?
qa.a: Yes. Inglewood is open Sat until 1 AM and Sun until 12 AM. Long Beach is open Sat and Sun until 11 PM. Both open at 10:30 AM.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: Inglewood: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302. Long Beach: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805. Compton is coming soon.

qa.q: What's the Inglewood address?
qa.a: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302.

qa.q: What's the Long Beach address?
qa.a: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805.

qa.q: Are you opening in Compton?
qa.a: Compton is coming soon, at 336 W Alondra Blvd, Compton, CA 90220. I don't have an opening date.

qa.q: How do I get directions?
qa.a: Tap the Directions button under the location you want in the app.

qa.q: Where can I park?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please ask staff or check the Directions map for the location.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
qa.a: I don't have a phone number to show. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: How far am I from Storm Burger?
qa.a: Turn on location in the app's map section to see how far you are. Your location stays on your phone.

qa.q: Is there a nearby offer?
qa.a: When you're near a location, the app may say: show it at the counter for double stars on today's order. Details are in the app.

qa.q: How do I order?
qa.a: Tap Order Inglewood or Order Long Beach in the app. You can also build your own burger or chicken sandwich and place the order.

qa.q: Can I order from the table with a QR code?
qa.a: The app mentions scanning the table QR to start earning stars when you're at the restaurant. I don't have more details on table ordering, so please ask staff.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: I don't have payment details. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Can I build my own burger?
qa.a: Yes. The app has a Build your burger tool with a Smash burger tab and a Chicken sandwich tab. Tap or drag toppings on, watch the price, then place your order.

qa.q: What toppings can I add to a burger?
qa.a: Smash patty (up to 3), American, Swiss, bacon, jalapeños, onion straws, lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles. The app shows each add-on's price.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: Combos, burgers, a Chicken Sandwich, Kids items, a Turkey Burger, shakes and homemade sauces. Chicken Strips, fries, onion rings and lemonade also appear in the app. Scroll the menu in the app to see each category.

qa.q: What combos do you have?
qa.a: Classic StormBurger Combo $11.99, Jalapeño Lightning Burger Combo $13.99, Kids Combo $11.99, Chicken Sandwich Combo $12.99.

qa.q: What comes with a combo?
qa.a: All combos come with fries and a soft drink.

qa.q: Can I upgrade my combo?
qa.a: Yes. Upgrade fries to onion rings for +$2.00, or your drink to a milkshake for +$2.00.

qa.q: What is the Jalapeño Lightning Burger?
qa.a: It has homemade avocado crema, Storm sauce, a 4oz patty, Swiss cheese, grilled onions and jalapeños. It's $6.99 by itself.

qa.q: What's the Classic StormBurger?
qa.a: It's the signature burger. The app builds it with Storm sauce, patty, cheese, pickles, onion, tomato and lettuce. The Classic StormBurger Combo is $11.99.

qa.q: Do you have a Turkey Burger?
qa.a: Yes. Two 2oz turkey patties with lettuce, tomato, cheese, onions, pickles and burger sauce, for $6.99.

qa.q: Do you have a kids menu?
qa.a: Yes. The Kids Burger (4oz patty, American cheese) is $5.99, and the Kids Combo with fries and a soft drink is $11.99.

qa.q: Do you have chicken?
qa.a: Yes. There's a Chicken Sandwich (Chicken Sandwich Combo $12.99) and Chicken Strips in the app. You can also build a chicken sandwich with a crispy or spicy (Thunder) fillet.

qa.q: How much is the chicken sandwich?
qa.a: The Chicken Sandwich Combo is $12.99, with fries and a soft drink.

qa.q: Do you have milkshakes?
qa.a: Yes. The Mix Shake is $4.99 ("Why not both?"). The app also lists vanilla and chocolate shakes.

qa.q: What sauces do you have?
qa.a: Homemade sauces are $1.00 each, including Storm (the signature burger sauce), BBQ, Honey Mustard and Spicy Mayo. Thunder and Ranch are also mentioned. Check the Sauces section of the menu for the full list.

qa.q: Do you have fries and onion rings?
qa.a: Yes, both are on the menu. Combos come with fries, and you can upgrade to onion rings for +$2.00.

qa.q: Do you have lemonade?
qa.a: Lemonade appears in the app. Ask staff about drink options, since I don't have a full drink list.

qa.q: Do you serve alcohol?
qa.a: I don't see alcohol on the menu in the app. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Are there vegetarian or allergy options?
qa.a: I don't have allergy or vegetarian details. Please ask staff before you order.

qa.q: Can I see 3D views of the food?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the 3D badge on a menu photo to see the dish drop onto a plate, or watch a burger build up layer by layer. Menu photos are AI-generated previews of the real items.

qa.q: Do you have holiday specials?
qa.a: Yes, seasonal specials show in the app during their dates. Halloween's Thunder Night Combo runs Oct 20-31 (code BOO). Thanksgiving's Gobble Burger runs Nov 20-28. Christmas's Holiday Shake Stack runs Dec 15-25. Ask staff to confirm.

qa.q: Do you have happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have any happy hour info. Please ask staff.

qa.q: How do I join the rewards program?
qa.a: Join StormBurger Rewards in the app. You'll need your name, phone number and email, and the app confirms your phone with a text code. It's free, one account per person and per phone.

qa.q: Is joining free?
qa.a: Yes. Membership is free, and no purchase is necessary to join or to play the game.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play the game?
qa.a: No. You can play Storm Run free with no account. You only need a free account to save your score or claim a prize.

qa.q: Is there a welcome offer?
qa.a: The sign-up offer shown is free fries with your next burger. Check the app for current details.

qa.q: How do I earn points?
qa.a: Show your member QR or code to staff when you order, and you earn 20 points for every $1 spent. You can also earn bonus points for check-ins, your first order, your birthday, feedback and referrals.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: 20 points per $1 spent when staff ring you up with your member code.

qa.q: How many points per visit?
qa.a: Your first QR check-in each day gives a 50-point visit bonus, on top of the 20 points per $1 you earn on your order.

qa.q: What's the daily check-in bonus?
qa.a: When staff scan your member QR or code, you get a 50-point bonus once a day.

qa.q: Is there a first-order bonus?
qa.a: Yes. Your first order earns a 100-point bonus.

qa.q: Do I get points for my birthday?
qa.a: Yes. The birthday bonus is 200 points. Add your birthday when you join.

qa.q: Do I get points for leaving feedback?
qa.a: Yes. Honest in-app feedback earns 250 points once, at any star rating. Google reviews do not earn points or prizes.

qa.q: Do I get points for a Google review?
qa.a: No. Reviews on Google never earn stars or prizes. The in-app feedback form is the one that earns 250 points.

qa.q: How does the referral program work?
qa.a: Share your code with a friend. When they join, you get 150 points and they get 50 points plus a free fries. After their first order you earn 100 more, then 25 each time they order. A Free Classic StormBurger referral gift is also listed.

qa.q: What rewards can I get with points?
qa.a: 1,000 pts = Free fries. 1,800 pts = Free shake. 3,000 pts = Free Classic StormBurger. 4,500 pts = Free combo.

qa.q: How many points for free fries?
qa.a: 1,000 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free shake?
qa.a: 1,800 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free burger?
qa.a: 3,000 points gets you a Free Classic StormBurger.

qa.q: How many points for a free combo?
qa.a: 4,500 points.

qa.q: How do I redeem my points?
qa.a: Pick a reward in the app when you have enough points, and show the code on your phone at the counter. I don't have more detail on the exact steps.

qa.q: Do points expire?
qa.a: I don't have any points-expiration info. Points have no cash value. Ask staff for details.

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: Yes. The app shows levels based on your visits this month (Member, Regular, VIP, Legend). Higher levels earn bonus point multipliers and perks. Check the app for yours.

qa.q: Do you have a birthday club?
qa.a: Yes. Add your birthday in your rewards account for a 200-point birthday bonus.

qa.q: What is the Daily Spin?
qa.a: A free wheel you can spin once a day as a member. Every slice wins something. It's never sold and never costs tokens.

qa.q: How often can I spin?
qa.a: Once per member per day (Los Angeles time).

qa.q: What can I win on the Daily Spin?
qa.a: +100 points (30%), +200 points (20%), +150 points (15%), free house sauce (15%), $2 off any burger (8%), free fries (7%), or 10% off your order (5%).

qa.q: How long are spin prizes good for?
qa.a: Food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at either location. One reward per visit, they can't be combined with other rewards, and they have no cash value.

qa.q: What is Storm Run?
qa.a: Storm Run is our free driving game. Steer the StormBurger food truck from Inglewood to Long Beach, grab coins and food, and dodge lightning, cows, stop signs, police and tornadoes.

qa.q: How do I play Storm Run?
qa.a: Tap the left or right side of the road to change lanes. You can also use the ◀ ▶ buttons under the game, or the arrow keys on a computer.

qa.q: How long is a Storm Run game?
qa.a: The rules say 45 seconds with 5 lives. The in-game clock shows your level and the seconds left, and you get level bonus points as you advance.

qa.q: How do lives work in Storm Run?
qa.a: You have 5 lives. Each hit costs half a life, so 10 hits and the truck is totaled.

qa.q: How do I score points in Storm Run?
qa.a: Coins are +10. StormBurger food is +30 to +60: Classic burger and Turkey Burger +60, Chicken Sandwich and Strips +50, shakes and lemonade +40, fries and onion rings +30. Staying on the road also scores, and you get a level bonus each level.

qa.q: What should I dodge in Storm Run?
qa.a: Lightning (move off the glowing target), flying cows, stop signs, police cars, roadblocks, spike strips, tornadoes and the drive-thru line. Cows and stop signs are −100 and a life.

qa.q: What does the glowing target mean?
qa.a: Lightning is about to strike right there, usually where your truck is. Change lanes in time.

qa.q: What are Antidote Drizzle emblems?
qa.a: Catch 5 Antidote Drizzle emblems (+25 each) to unlock Antidote's StormBurger review on a roadside billboard. Drive through its golden ▶ for a +500 bonus.

qa.q: What is the Jordan High pit stop?
qa.a: A pit stop on levels 3, 6 and 9. Pull in and you get 20 seconds to build burger orders by tapping ingredients in ticket order. Each finished burger is +75 and repairs the truck by 1 life.

qa.q: What do I win in Storm Run?
qa.a: One run over 400 = Free house sauce, 600 = Free fries or onion rings, 800 = Free milkshake, 1,000 = Free Classic StormBurger. Prizes are based only on your score, not chance.

qa.q: How do I claim my game prize?
qa.a: Finish a run, then save your prize to your free rewards account to get your code. Show the code and your account on your phone at the counter.

qa.q: How long do game prizes last?
qa.a: Use them within 3 days. You can hold one prize at a time. Your next win saves after you use the current one.

qa.q: How often can I play Storm Run?
qa.a: As often as you like, for free. The current version has no limit and needs no tokens.

qa.q: Do I need tokens to play?
qa.a: No. Storm Run is free to play right now and doesn't need tokens.

qa.q: What is the weekly prize?
qa.a: The highest Storm Run score from Monday through Sunday close wins a Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: Save your scores to your account and the top score of the week wins. Ties go to the score posted first, and the board resets every Monday.

qa.q: When does the weekly contest end?
qa.a: The week runs Monday through Sunday close. The app's champion card counts down to Sunday 11 PM. The board resets every Monday.

qa.q: When are weekly prizes picked?
qa.a: I don't have exact pickup timing. Last week's top 3 show on the app's champion card, and winners can show their code at the counter. Ask staff for details.

qa.q: Where can I see my best score?
qa.a: Your best score shows under the game as "Your best," saved on this phone.

qa.q: Who can play and win?
qa.a: U.S. residents age 13 or older. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission. Employees and their households can play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: Can kids play?
qa.a: Yes, ages 13 and up, and under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission. There's no separate kid mode in the app.

qa.q: Are cheats allowed?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: Where are the official rules?
qa.a: Tap "Game & daily spin official rules" at the bottom of the app. Note that the posted rules are marked as a draft.

qa.q: Do I have to buy something to play or win?
qa.a: No. No purchase is necessary to play Storm Run, spin the wheel or win a prize, and buying doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: Can I turn the sound off?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the Sound button under the game. There's also a music button to switch songs (Energy or Cheat Code).

qa.q: Can I change the game view or graphics?
qa.a: Yes. In game Settings you can pick the 3D chase cam or Classic 2D, and choose a graphics level (Smooth is recommended).

qa.q: Can I use a game controller?
qa.a: Yes. Xbox, PlayStation and other controllers work in most browsers. Steer with the stick or D-pad. Pair it, then press any button.

qa.q: Why did a video pop up during the game?
qa.a: After about 90 seconds of total play, a short halftime shows clips of Antidote The Foodie's StormBurger review. You can skip it, watch the full review on YouTube, or go back to the game.

qa.q: Do you have trivia or sports features?
qa.a: I don't see trivia or sports features in the app. There's a halftime review video during the game.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Use the 🌐 language button for English, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Korean, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Armenian, Persian, Japanese, Thai and Russian. Restaurant and game names stay in English.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: Use "Add to Home Screen" in the app or the footer. On iPhone, tap Share then Add to Home Screen. On Android, use the ⋮ menu or the Install button. It then opens like an app.

qa.q: Is there a wallet card?
qa.a: I don't have any wallet card info. You can add the app to your Home Screen for one-tap access to your rewards.

qa.q: Where can I see Storm Burger's Instagram?
qa.a: Look for the Instagram section in the app, @stormburger. You can watch posts and reels right there.

qa.q: Can I leave a Google review?
qa.a: Yes. The app has a Write a Google review button. Honest reviews only, and they don't earn points.

qa.q: How is my information used?
qa.a: Only for your rewards account, and it's never sold. Marketing texts are optional and unchecked by default, and you can stop texts and emails anytime by replying STOP or unsubscribing.

qa.q: How do I stop texts?
qa.a: Reply STOP to any text, or unsubscribe from emails.

qa.q: Who do I ask if I need help?
qa.a: Ask staff at the counter. I don't have a phone number to give you.
